

## Selected variables summary


| Variable | Role | Source | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `pct_pob_25_39` | indicator and predictor | 6 | Share of the neighbourhood's population aged 25-39. |
| `nivel_estudios_superiores_pct` | indicator and predictor | 8 | Share of the population with completed higher education. |
| `renta_neta_media_persona` | indicator and predictor | 5 | Average net income per person in the neighbourhood. |
| `pct_hog_unipersonal_bajo65` | indicator and predictor | 2 | Share of single-person households with the resident aged under 65. |
| `precio_vivienda_declarado_barrio` | indicator and predictor | 4 | Average declared housing sale price registered by the Colegio de Registradores for the neighbourhood. |
| `pct_extranjeros_ue_ocde` | indicator and predictor | 8 | Share of the population holding EU/OECD foreign nationality. |
| `pct_hog_monoparental` | predictor | 2 | Share of households that are single-parent households (one adult with one or more children). |
| `pct_hog_dos_adultos_sin_menores` | predictor | 2 | Share of households with two adults aged 16-64 with no children. |
| `renta_colectiva_barrio` | predictor | 3 | Median rental price of multi-family housing in the neighbourhood, built as a dwelling-weighted mean of its census tracts' median rents. |
| `poblacion_total_barrio` | predictor | 6 | Total resident population of the neighbourhood. |
| `tasa_transacciones_vivienda` | predictor | 7 | Housing sale transactions per inhabitant in the neighbourhood. |
| `tasa_paro` | predictor | 17 | Registered unemployment rate in the neighbourhood (measured in December of each year). |
| `densidad` | predictor | 8 | Population density: inhabitants per hectare of the neighbourhood's surface area. |
| `tamano_hogar` | predictor | 8 | Average household size (mean number of people per household). |
| `envejecimiento` | predictor | 8 | Population aging ratio (share of elderly population >65)|
| `sobreenvejecimiento` | predictor | 8 | Over-aging ratio (share of the population >80 within the elderly population) |
| `pct_uso_vivienda` | predictor | 9 | Share of all registered business/premises whose declared status is residential use |
| `n_locales_activos_total` | predictor | 9 | Total number of open (active) business premises in the neighbourhood. |
| `pct_comercio_menor` | predictor | 9 | Share of active business premises devoted to retail trade ("Comercio al por menor"). |
| `pct_turismo_alojamiento` | predictor | 9 | Share of active business premises devoted to tourist accommodation (hotels and similar and tourist housing). |
| `pct_bares_restaurantes` | predictor | 9 | Share of active business premises devoted to bars and restaurants. |
| `pct_inmobiliarias` | predictor | 9 | Share of active business premises devoted to real-estate agencies. |
| `pct_arte_recreo_ocio` | predictor | 9 | Share of active business premises devoted to arts, recreation and leisure activities. |
| `tasa_entradas_totales` | predictor | 10 | Rate of new municipal entries (internal + external "altas") per inhabitant, capturing in-migration into the neighbourhood. |
| `tasa_salidas_totales` | predictor | 10 | Rate of municipal de-registrations (internal + external "bajas") per inhabitant, capturing out-migration from the neighbourhood. |
| `intensidad_inversion_real_distrito` | predictor | 11 | District-level actual municipal spending execution per inhabitant|
| `share_gasto_real_urbanismo` | predictor | 12 | Share of the district's actual municipal spending allocated to urbanism |
| `share_gasto_real_mantenimiento_urbano` | predictor | 12 | Share of the district's actual municipal spending allocated to urban maintenance |
| `share_gasto_real_medio_ambiente` | predictor | 12 | Share of the district's actual municipal spending allocated to the environment |
| `share_gasto_real_cultura` | predictor | 12 | Share of the district's actual municipal spending allocated to culture |
| `pct_poblacion_idh_alto_distrito` | predictor | 13 | Share of the district's population born abroad in a country with high or very high HDI (>0.7) |
| `zonas_verdes_significativas_m2_per_capita_distrito` | predictor | 14 | District-level surface area of significant parks and green spaces per inhabitant (m2 per capita). |
| `paradas_red_centro` | predictor | 15 | Minimum number of metro-network segments from the neighbourhood's own station(s) to Sol along the shortest path, used as a network-distance-to-center measure |
| `n_estaciones_metro` | predictor | 15 | Number of metro stations located within the neighbourhood's boundaries. |
| `distancia_centro_lineal_m` | predictor | 16 | Straight-line (Euclidean) distance, in meters, from the neighbourhood's geometric centroid to the centroid of Sol. |
